grammar.title: Intentional actions with 故意
grammar.explanation: 故意 (gùyì) means "on purpose, intentionally" it describes an action done deliberately, often with a hint of blame.

sentences.en: He didn't do it on purpose.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ shì gùyì ràng wǒ děng ma?
sentences.en: Are you making me wait on purpose?

sentences.zh: 我不是故意说这句话的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì gùyì shuō zhè jù huà de.
sentences.en: I didn't mean to say that on purpose.
He's intentionally not answering the phone.
